203	who will use you to advance themselves. When you are
204	in distress, they will try to exploit you. You have to be very
205	careful about that. There are people who wait to see distress only
206	to exploit people's troubles. You have to

208	wants your good, cares about you, share with him. The rest of

212	"Turn from evil" is what you have to be careful about.
213	"Do good" is what you need to initiate and act on
214	in order to solve problems,
215	in order to lower the worry a person has in the heart.
216	So we saw "he will divert it from his mind," "he will talk it over with others," and that
217	lowers it. But what can one do to still get out of
218	this pressure, this worry?

220	good word?
221	What do these words mean? A good thing that can
222	bring a person joy.
223	There are three paths in this, which every person who is worried
224	should combine, after making the effort
225	to divert it from his mind and share with others. Three things
226	that can help a person so that a good word will make him glad.

229	does is for the good. That is a good thing. That is, reflect
230	also on what you see today
231	that is not good, and you suffer and it is hard for you. There is
232	something good hidden in the matter.
